#   lang           — BCP-47 language code (en / te / hi / ...)

#   to look up tile_x / tile_y at zoom level 7 for the city's coordinates.
# To ADD A LANGUAGE to an existing city: add a new row with the same city_id
#   and the new lang code. The city will automatically appear in that language's
#   list_cities response after the next build.
# To REMOVE A CITY or translation: delete its row(s). The next build removes it.
